title: Kiritani Haruka — You Deserve It〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: A few days before the show
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, that should be enough practice for today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Great work everyone!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm gonna head home now!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Stay safe.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori's really been putting everything into it lately.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She has, but I hope she isn't pushing herself too hard.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm a little worried about that too...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But she's been singing and dancing really well, so I feel like we should let her be for now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sure she'll be fine...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She even asked me the other day to believe in her...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So I feel like I should honor her request.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Believe in her, huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: By the way, are you two free after this?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I have some time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Same here, as long as I'm not out too late...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In that case, how does a little shopping sound? I'd like to look for a few things that might help Minori stay in good shape.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Things for staying in good shape?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. For example, an icy spray that helps prevent muscle aches after you do a hard workout...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I see. That sounds much more serious than what I had in mind.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Right, okay...
That might've been a bad example...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sometimes you sound more like an athlete than an idol, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Haha. I did play basketball for a while too...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I'm glad I asked. This is why I'd like some help with finding something for Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Of course we'll help.
It's for Minori's sake, after all.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But you're gonna have a lot to choose from...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. Maybe something that can help her relax might work since I feel like she's always pushing herself so hard...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah... Then how about some bath salts?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Their color and fragrance alone have a great relaxing effect. I'm sure she'll feel a lot better even after a quick dip!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Or maybe even a CD with some relaxing sounds or music...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The ones with birds chirping or babbling brooks are much less expensive than regular CDs, so you could get her quite a few.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That also sounds nice. A good night's rest would go a long way for Minori too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, it sounds like we have a plan!
Let's get going, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's!
The next day

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, everyone else is already here.
Good morning...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Good morning, Minori.
Do you have some time before we start?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We thought you deserved a little reward for all your hard work lately so... Here!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh...! Floral bath salts!
It's so cute too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It'll definitely help your mind and body relax more too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A nice bath with this is the best cure for a hard day's work!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
And my gift is this...
A relaxing CD featuring the sounds of little birds chirping. I'm sure it'll help you get a good night's rest.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, wow...! Thank you so much, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
And last but not least, me...
I had Airi and Shizuku help me pick this one out.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
A heated eye pillow...?
With a penguin design!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. There's even a little pocket that lets you put in aroma packets to help you relax even more.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's the same as the one I use at home, but in a different color. They work quite well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?! That means... Mine matches yours?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It does. Also, as much as I like penguins, I was sort of worried about getting you the same thing...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, I'm happy you did!
Thanks, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
And thank you again, Airi, Shizuku!
I'm so... So happy that...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, you big baby!
You don't need to exaggerate.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
B-But...!
Your gifts are so thoughtful...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And we're going to believe in you just like you asked too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So let's make sure our show becomes a big success!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, let's give it everything we've got today too!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah!
